articles.title: Maharashtra: Samruddhi Mahamarg Gets Nearly 4,000 AI Cameras As ₹1,700-Crore ITMS Project Gains Pace
articles.description: Nearly 4,000 AI-enabled cameras are being installed on the Samruddhi Mahamarg under Maharashtra's Rs 1,700-crore Intelligent Traffic Management System project. The cameras will detect 17 types of traffic violations, while the system will support road safety, emergency response, traffic monitoring and security along the expressway.
